EmailTemplate.description: Post-deposit, take your next steps: housing, orientation, priority tasks
EmailTemplate.name: FTF Housing and Orientation Push (Post-Enrollment Deposit)
EmailTemplate.subject: Confirm your housing preferences and register for orientation!
EmailTemplate.textOnly:
Hello {!Contact.FirstName},
Congratulations and welcome to the Sun Devil family! By paying your enrollment deposit, you have taken the next step to becoming an official Sun Devil.
Now you get to confirm your housing preferences and sign up for an orientation date in My ASU (http://my.asu.edu/).
Orientation All admitted first-time freshmen are required to attend orientation. Register as soon as possible to get your ideal date. Reservations are taken on a first-come, first-served basis and program dates fill quickly. Once a program has filled, that program date is no longer available and will not appear for reservations. View more information on orientation at https://eoss.asu.edu/orientation.
Housing First-time freshmen are expected to live on campus their first year at ASU. Housing is guaranteed, but preferences are first-come, first-served. We encourage you to select your housing preferences as soon as possible at https://my.asu.edu. View more information on housing at https://housing.asu.edu/.
Keep checking your Priority Tasks in My ASU (http://my.asu.edu/) and complete items as soon as possible to enroll at ASU.
If you have any questions about the admission process or ASU in general, I'd be happy to help you in any way I can.
We look forward to seeing you at ASU.
Go Devils!
{!User.Recruiter_Full_Name__c} {!User.Recruiter_Title__c} Admission Services {!User.Recruiter_Email__c} {!User.Recruiter_Phone__c}
If you have any additional information or questions related to this, please reply to this email.
